title: Waiting Period — Kessler Shield Vehicle Service Contracts Contract Terms
content:
**Clause.** Under a Kessler Shield Vehicle Service Contracts contract, a failure is covered only after the waiting period. The waiting period ends once both of the following hold:
- the coverage level's waiting-period days have passed, counted in calendar days since the sale date;
- the vehicle has been driven the coverage level's waiting miles beyond the odometer at sale.

A failure first reported on a repair order dated within the waiting period is denied with the reason waiting period. So is a failure first reported at an odometer within the waiting miles.

**No waiting period on a deal sale.** Where the coverage level waives the waiting period for a contract sold with the vehicle, a contract sold on the vehicle's purchase deal has no waiting period. Such a contract is one whose record carries the purchase deal it was sold on.

**Related benefits.** Towing and roadside assistance follow the same waiting period as the repair they relate to.

**How the days are counted.**
- The clock starts on the sale date shown on the contract record. The sale date is day 0, and the waiting days are added to it as calendar days.
- A failure reported on a repair order dated on that last day is still within the waiting period.
- A failure reported after that day is outside the waiting period on time.
- The mileage condition is checked separately. Both conditions must be met.

**Boundary cases (hypothetical, waiting days of 30 and waiting miles of 1000, odometer at sale 30400).**

| Repair order date | Repair order odometer | Days condition | Miles condition | Waiting period over? |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 30th day after the sale date | 31900 | not met (on the last day) | met | no, denied for waiting period |
| 31st day after the sale date | 31900 | met | met | yes |
| 31st day after the sale date | 31399 | met | not met (999 beyond) | no, denied for waiting period |
| 31st day after the sale date | 31400 | met | met (1000 beyond) | yes |
| 12th day after the sale date, contract sold on the purchase deal | 30600 | no waiting period | no waiting period | yes |
